svg.title: Projects
svg.desc: Project list rows: a multimodal NLP rating-prediction project and a reinforcement-guided hallucination-mitigation project, each with a title, description, and tech stack meta line.

g.text: 01 / A Multimodal NLP Approach to Sentiment and Rating Prediction
Predictive machine learning pipeline designed to analyze review text and features to accurately forecast user ratings.
Utilizes natural language processing, exploratory data analysis, and feature engineering to evaluate sentiment patterns
PYTHON • MACHINE LEARNING • NLP • SCIKIT-LEARN • PANDAS • EDA • SENTIMENT ANALYSIS
Training-free inference framework that mitigates hallucinations in LLMs by dynamically editing hidden-state
representations at identified factual pivot layers. Utilizes an asynchronous REINFORCE policy agent and a twin
structural autoencoder guardrail to apply norm-bounded corrective vectors, significantly boosting factual accuracy
across benchmarks without altering underlying model parameters.
PYTHON • PYTORCH • TRANSFORMERS • BITSANDBYTES • HUGGING FACE • REINFORCE • SCIKIT-LEARN • TRUTHX • VECTOR DATABASE (RAG)
